prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: Magic Mirror billboard brandbook mockup
Primary request: Create one cinematic, realistic street-level photograph of a large Magic Mirror fashion billboard, using the supplied production lockup exactly.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact approved Acid combined lockup. Preserve the full editorial lettering, spacing, proportions, and the custom S-curve lens icon replacing the ‘o’ in ‘Mirror.’
Scene/backdrop: contemporary fashion district at blue hour with restrained unbranded architecture, subtle city depth, and a few distant anonymous pedestrians; no visible store names, advertising, signs, or other brands.
Subject: one large, clean Ink #17171A billboard carrying only the exact Image 1 combined lockup in Acid #D7FF3F, centered with generous clear space.
Style/medium: premium photorealistic environmental advertising photography with credible urban materials and construction.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2 frame; billboard dominant, nearly front-facing, and large enough that the complete Magic Mirror lockup remains crisp and legible at brandbook page scale; useful architectural context without visual competition.
Lighting/mood: moody editorial blue-hour city light with realistic billboard illumination; energetic, fashion-forward, and premium.
Color palette: Acid #D7FF3F and Ink #17171A for the billboard design; natural restrained cool environmental colors outside it.
Text (verbatim): no additional text. The supplied lockup is the only visible copy in the entire image.
Materials/textures: convincing billboard surface and frame, subtle light falloff, realistic reflections and shadows; artwork physically integrated with the display surface.
Constraints: preserve the complete supplied lockup at very high fidelity; keep its spelling and custom lens ‘o’ unchanged; show only one billboard and one copy of the lockup.
Avoid: fake fashion brands, storefront lettering, street-sign text, extra logos, duplicated signage, altered spelling, added slogans, gradients or glow inside the lockup, watermark, extreme perspective, blocked lettering, excessive distance, visual clutter.

logo_fidelity.notes: Magic Mirror is correctly spelled; the editorial letterforms, custom lens o, and focus detail are recognizable and materially undistorted.

page_scale_legibility.notes: The billboard dominates the frame and remains crisp, nearly front-facing, and readable at page scale.

copy_accuracy.notes: The supplied lockup is the only visible copy; no slogan or environmental signage was introduced.

physical_integration.notes: The lockup follows the billboard surface and illumination with credible framing, light falloff, and ambient shadows.

palette_compliance.notes: The designed billboard uses the approved Acid-on-Ink pairing; restrained cool city colors appear only in the environment.

stray_branding_and_watermarks.notes: No store brands, fake fashion brands, extra logos, duplicated signage, or watermarks are visible.

brand_tone.notes: Blue-hour architecture and restrained street activity create a premium editorial fashion-district context.

page_ready_crop.notes: The 3:2 crop gives the billboard architectural context while preserving strong hierarchy and clean edges.

decision: Accepted the first complete ImageGen pass. It cleared the approximately 95% mockup gate, so the permitted targeted retry and compositing fallback were not used.
